entities.summary: Visigothic, a notable figure in the history of Spain, associated with Roman Hispania (19 BCE–476). Preceded by Imperial Hispania & Romanisation and Siege and fall of Numantia – symbol of Celtiberian resistance. Their legacy influenced Umayyad forces under Tariq ibn Ziyad defeat the Visigoths at Guadalete.
